beats.text: Washington says it controls the Strait of Hormuz. Iran says it's closed. So, is it open?
Before the war, about a hundred and thirty ships crossed every day. Recently? Eight. Eight very brave ships.

beats.speaker: fatima
beats.text: So we pay higher gas prices to wait for a deal that might not happen. Classic economic strategy.
beats.name: Fatima

beats.text: Tehran wants sanctions lifted and a wider ceasefire first. A draft deal is ready. Getting both sides to sign it is the hard part.
So, is the strait open? Washington says yes, Tehran says no, and the tankers would like a second opinion.

plan.hook: Is Hormuz Open? Depends Who Asks
